mainEntity.name: How much should a small business budget for AI without wasting money?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The right budget depends on the AI platform, connected software, training materials, and amount of hands-on setup. A sensible first step is to test a free or lower-cost option, then pay for features only when the workflow demonstrates value.

Context: Run My AI Biz lists a free starting option and a $9-per-month paid newsletter subscription for fuller weekly educational issues. Those subscriptions provide education; they do not automatically configure every external tool or guarantee business results.

Key factors:
- Subscription and usage limits
- Integration fees
- Setup and maintenance time
- Value of the task being improved

Practical guidance: Calculate the current weekly time or expense for the target task and compare it with total monthly tool costs. Keep a cancellation threshold if the pilot does not produce measurable improvement.

Run My AI Biz helps owners learn what to compare before committing to a larger implementation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with the lowest-cost option that can test one useful workflow. Include AI subscriptions, connected software, usage charges, and your own setup time. Compare total monthly cost with measurable time saved, fewer errors, or improved output before upgrading.
